description:
One of the caller's saved products bought from its own lane or from a
second lane, side by side: the first lane is the caller's own plan, the
second is that plan with only this product's quote, duty and lead time
changed. The two plans are alternatives, never added up.

`second_origin` names the second lane's origin; `product_id` picks the
product (default: the first in `navigator.products`).
`second_quote_gbp_per_unit` and `second_lead_time_months` describe the
second lane. Each lane carries its own `status`, `compromises`,
`orders_units`, `cash_gbp` and `total_cost_gbp`, and
`unit_cost_provenance`, `lead_time_provenance` and `duty_provenance`
(READ; duty is empty when no rate was found). `available: false` with
`missing` when the comparison cannot be built.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: compare_lanes
title: Compare lanes
